The licence is as Commons records it. Identified as this saint because: Commons describes it “Saint Spyridon Icon in Ano Melas (Gorno Statitsa) Church”, a 1720 icon filed under “Icons in Kastoria”. Spyridon the wonderworker, bishop of Trimythous in Cyprus, is the only saint venerated under that name in the Greek and Slavic calendars, and he is shown here in the bishop's wicker mitre by which he is always recognised. Commons describes it: Saint Spyridon Icon in Ano Melas (Gorno Statitsa) Church.
